existing_proofs_preserved: The full per-block source body covers HAS_SCALE both ways, signed program-id conversion, masking, max/exp/sum/log/add, scalar write and frame. Existing grid-family lemmas quantify each block from the initial state, and public Real IO gives blockLSE. FPCorrect provides a complete fp32 backend graph; software bindings keep exp/log/max explicit and retain a nonempty padded-lane witness. These are preserved as block-stage results.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Complete scaled/unscaled block-LSE stage is represented.
View, temporary allocation/grid, subsequent torch logsumexp across blocks, output reshape and optional dtype cast are not composed.

dtype_review: The FP source profile is fixed fp32 input/output, whereas original x storage is unrestricted and z is always fp32. The optional final dtype can select other output types. Existing generic Real block theorem erases these storage distinctions; the software primitive profile also specializes scale=1 and does not replace the general backend-parametric scaled result.
branch_review: HAS_SCALE is already represented as both Bool branches; no absent-scale-branch finding is made. ND may exceed1 because B is capped at65536; even ND1 still executes the host z.logsumexp stage. None/default-float versus other-dtype output branches are original source stages that must remain visible.

structural_gaps.finding: After the Triton grid, Python calls z.logsumexp(-1).view(*shape[:-1]); public results stop at one scalar per row/block.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The final reduction over partial LSEs is an omitted original stage, especially for D>65536. A numerical log/exp assumption cannot supply this graph and composition.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper views x, allocates fp32 z, launches (N,ND), then conditionally casts final output dtype.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Per-block IO and ForAllProgramsSome do not establish the actual shared intermediate tensor followed by host return/reshape/cast behavior.

structural_gaps.finding: rowBlock fixes x and z to fp32, while original loads x with its own storage and an optional scale before fp32 z store.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Other admitted input promotions/storage conversions require exact structural routes; generic fp32 primitive deferrals alone do not cover them.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Native max/exp/log, ordered fp32 reductions, multiplication and casts may be deferred at exact profiles. Padded lanes remain in the typed graph; negative/zero scale and nonfinite behavior must not be silently replaced by a finite-real identity.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
